subject: MedLogic RFP: Eval stipend and onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara@medlogic.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medlogic.com
Date: Tue, 7 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MedLogic RFP: Eval plan and benchmark scope

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our evaluation committee wants to run a two-week side-by-side bakeoff against two competing vendors (Vendor A and Vendor B). High level ask: ~2M tokens of generation + 40k embedding units for similarity/rerank tests. Can Redwood reserve a dedicated eval stipend we can use during the bakeoff window (May 20–June 3)?

A few constraints from procurement/legal:
- We need a short credit agreement and a copy of your SOC2 evidence checklist.
- Can credits be split across two project workspaces so our infra and research teams can run parallel tests?

Attaching our RFP scope doc. Who should I loop in on the Redwood side for contract/ops?

Appreciate it,
Sara
Sara Liu
Procurement & Vendor Ops
MedLogic Health

Attachment: medlogic-rfp-scope.pdf (doc stub)

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara@medlogic.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MedLogic RFP: Eval plan and benchmark scope

Hi Sara — great to meet yesterday and thanks for the clear scope. Short answers up front: yes, we can allocate a reserved eval stipend for the bakeoff and split it across two workspaces.

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll provision a 2M-token generation + 40k-embedding credit pool scoped to two workspaces.
2) Neha will confirm the internal approval and any guardrails (expiry, allowed endpoints).
3) I'll share a short evaluation credit agreement for procurement to countersign (PDF).
4) We'll send SOC2 artifacts for your security review.

Couple of items we need from you to finalize:
- Confirm exact workspace names (Research-Team and Infra-Team) to reserve credits.
- Confirm whether you want the full pool available from day 1 or split release (we can time-box the second half).

Looping in Neha and Marcus for ops/approval and accounting.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Sales Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 May 2028 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: MedLogic eval stipend allocation (pre-approval)

Avery/Marcus — quick internal note before I send official approval to Sara/procurement.

Summary of ask: 2,000,000 gen tokens + 40,000 embedding units, split across two workspaces. Bakeoff window 2028-05-20 to 2028-06-03.

Recommendation (ops):
- Approve the full pool but add the following guardrails:
  * Expiry: 2028-06-10 (one week post window).
  * Restricted model list: rwd-7b-q4f, rwd-13b-opt (to keep cost bounded).
  * Token throttling: 30 tps max to avoid noisy load on shared infra.
- Require signed eval credit agreement and confirmation of workspace IDs from procurement.

Finance note: estimated cost to Redwood (on our side) ~ $2.4k USD; ok to treat as marketing/sales promotional credit. Marcus — can you confirm GL code to charge?

I'll draft the credit agreement and SOC2 asset list to send to Sara after Marcus confirms GL.

-Neha
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Liu <sara@medlogic.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medlogic.com
Date: Wed, 8 May 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MedLogic RFP: Eval plan and benchmark scope

Thanks — that all sounds promising. A couple of clarifications from procurement:
- Can the credit expiry be extended by 72 hours if one of our vendor runs is delayed? We sometimes need a short buffer.
- We have two separate budgets (research and infra). Is it possible to show the credits applied separately on an invoice or dashboard for internal chargeback?

Also - procurement asked if we can get the credit agreement and your SOC2 checklist by Friday (May 10) so we can complete vendor review before the bakeoff kickoff.

Thanks,
Sara

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara@medlogic.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, procurement@medlogic.com
Date: Thu, 9 May 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MedLogic RFP: Eval plan and benchmark scope

Sara — all set. Internal approvals completed this morning. Summary of what we've provisioned and next steps:

Provisioned credits:
- 2,000,000 generation tokens (rwd-7b-q4f & rwd-13b-opt)
- 40,000 embedding units
- Split into two workspaces: Research-Team (1.2M gen + 24k embed), Infra-Team (0.8M gen + 16k embed)
- Expiry: 2028-06-10 (standard) — we will allow a one-time 72-hour extension upon written request by procurement.

Docs attached: redwood-eval-credit-agreement.pdf (short form), signed-nda-medlogic.pdf, medlogic-onboarding-checklist.xlsx

Operational notes and links:
- Credits are visible in the Redwoods Console under Workspace IDs: ML-Research-009 and ML-Infra-011.
- You can export per-workspace usage for chargeback; we'll send a CSV snapshot at the bakeoff close.
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company/contacts/HL-49382 (Deal DL-8721).

Next steps for MedLogic:
1) Procurement signs the attached credit agreement and returns to legal@redwood.ai.
2) Confirm the two workspace IDs are correct (reply-all).
3) Kick off bakeoff on May 20 — we'll stand up a war room channel and provide a short onboarding call the week prior (May 17-18).

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if procurement wants to walk through the agreement.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Sales Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-eval-credit-agreement.pdf (credit agreement stub), medlogic-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (ops checklist), signed-nda-medlogic.pdf (NDA stub)
